meta.zeroFillRule: The Premier League stat feed omits many zeroes. If a player has minutes or appearances, a catalog stat missing from their payload is stored as 0 with reported=false. Players with neither minutes nor appearances are not zero-filled.
meta.ratingRule: Per-90 rates are published from 90 minutes. Percentiles are mid-ranks from 270 minutes, among players in that stat's peer group. Ratios are published only once the attempt minimum is met. These percentiles are calculated from the published numbers. They are not official Premier League ratings.
notPublished: Pace is not in either feed.
A single strength or physicality attribute is not in either feed. Aerial duels and body measurements are stored instead.
Post-shot expected goals and goals prevented are not in either feed, so they are not calculated.

featuredDefinitions.label: Shooting
featuredDefinitions.source: Fantasy Premier League bootstrap-static, Opta expected goals, 2026/27

featuredDefinitions.label: Pass completion
featuredDefinitions.formula: accurate_pass / total_pass, published at 270 minutes and at least 50 passes

featuredDefinitions.label: Vision
featuredDefinitions.source: Fantasy Premier League bootstrap-static, Opta expected assists, 2026/27

featuredDefinitions.label: Chance creation
featuredDefinitions.formula: total_att_assist / (mins_played / 90). total_att_assist is the feed's shot-creating pass count.

featuredDefinitions.label: Save percentage
featuredDefinitions.formula: saves / (saves + goals_conceded), published once that denominator reaches 15. Own goals are not removed; the feed does not publish a separate own-goal split on every goalkeeper.
